title: Molybdate templated assembly of Ln12Mo4-type clusters (Ln = Sm, Eu, Gd) containing a truncated tetrahedron core

material_class.structural_family: Ln12Mo4 cluster with a distorted truncated-tetrahedron Ln12 core templated by four molybdate anions

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of rac-3-aminopropane-1,2-diol (23 mg, 0.25 mmol) and 2-hydroxybenzaldehyde (26 μL, 0.25 mmol) in methanol (18 mL) was refluxed for 2 h to form the Schiff base rac-H3L in situ. Gd(CH3COO)3·3H2O (0.192 mg, 0.5 mmol), (n-Bu4N)4Mo8O26 (60 mg, 0.028 mmol) and triethylamine (109 μL, 0.75 mmol) were added with stirring at room temperature. After a further 30 min, the mixture was sealed in a 23 mL Teflon-lined Parr vessel and heated at 90 °C for 12 h. Slow evaporation of the filtrate gave pale-yellow block crystals. The stated acetate mass (0.192 mg) and amount (0.5 mmol) are transcribed as printed and are mutually inconsistent.
synthesis.time: 2 h reflux; 30 min stirring; 12 h heating
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in a 23 mL Teflon-lined Parr autoclave
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow evaporation of the filtrate afforded pale-yellow block-shaped crystals.

properties.summary: DC susceptibility of polycrystalline 1 shows weak antiferromagnetic coupling between Gd(III) ions: χMT is 95.2 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K (1000 Oe), near the spin-only value 94.5 cm3 mol−1 K for 12 uncoupled Gd(III), and falls to 50.6 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K. Nearest-neighbour exchange was fitted as J = −0.04 K (2J Heisenberg Hamiltonian) by classical Monte Carlo and FTLM. Magnetization saturates easily near 6 T. The magnetocaloric effect reaches −ΔSm = 35.3 J kg−1 K−1 at 3 K for ΔH = 7 T, below the calculated 41.6 J kg−1 K−1 for 12 uncorrelated Gd(III) spins; isentropes suggest sub-kelvin cooling may be accessible.
